description:
Search the mobile phone plans of every operator in Lithuania, Latvia or Estonia, as compared on
PriceBee. Prices are in euros, per month unless price_period says otherwise, from the
operators' own sites, updated daily. Use it whenever someone wants a mobile, SIM-only, prepaid
or data plan, or to compare operators. Set only the filters the user actually asked for.
Each plan's pricebee_url (Lithuania) or order_url is the link to give the user.

audience.description: Plans made for this group only (e.g. seniors, pupils).

commitment.description: Contract length: none (cancel any time), 12 or 24 months.

country.description: lt Lithuania (default), lv Latvia, ee Estonia.

data_in_eu.description: Only plans with data while roaming in the EU.

esim.description: Only plans the operator says work with an eSIM.

for_devices.description: true: IoT plans for trackers, alarms and other devices instead of phones.

max_monthly_price_eur.description: Highest monthly price in euros (per month even for weekly or daily plans).

min_data_gb.description: At least this much mobile data per month, in GB. Unlimited plans match too.

min_minutes.description: At least this many call minutes. Unlimited plans match too.

operator.description: Only this operator, by name or domain, e.g. "Telia", "tele2.lt", "LMT".

prepaid.description: true: only prepaid (pay as you go); false: only contract plans.

sort.description: price_asc cheapest first (default), popular, data_desc most data, minutes_desc most minutes.

streaming.description: Only plans that include a streaming service (Netflix, Disney+, Go3, ...).

unlimited_data.description: Only plans with unlimited mobile data.

name: search_mobile_plans
title: Search mobile plans
